progress.queued: Queued: waiting for the scan worker.
progress.downloading_snapshot: Downloading a read-only snapshot of the repository…
progress.snapshot_ready_skipped_one: Snapshot ready: {{count}} file to analyze, {{skipped}} skipped because they aren't code.
progress.snapshot_ready_skipped_other: Snapshot ready: {{count}} files to analyze, {{skipped}} skipped because they aren't code.
progress.finished_incomplete: Finished with incomplete coverage: {{counts}}. Check above what didn't run.
progress.pr_excluded_one: {{count}} finding in paths an administrator excluded is left out of the review.
progress.pr_excluded_other: {{count}} findings in paths an administrator excluded are left out of the review.
progress.pr_summary_one: {{count}} new finding introduced by the PR; {{preexisting}} already existed.
progress.pr_summary_other: {{count}} new findings introduced by the PR; {{preexisting}} already existed.
progress.pr_summary_no_baseline_one: {{count}} new finding introduced by the PR; {{preexisting}} already existed (no earlier scan of the target branch: counting what falls on changed lines).
progress.pr_summary_no_baseline_other: {{count}} new findings introduced by the PR; {{preexisting}} already existed (no earlier scan of the target branch: counting what falls on changed lines).
progress.no_comment_permission: The result wasn't posted to GitHub: the App can't write to pull requests.

failure.restart: The server restarted while this run was in progress, so it was interrupted. Run it again.
failure.internal: The scan failed with an internal error; your team can check the server logs using the run ID.
failure.image_internal: The image scan failed with an internal error; check the logs using the run ID.
failure.pr_internal: The review failed with an internal error; your team can check the server logs using the run ID.

delivery.no_comment_permission: no permission: the App needs write access to Pull requests
delivery.no_status_permission: no permission: the App needs write access to Commit statuses

batch.already_running: A batch is already running: wait for it to finish or cancel it

imports.detail_full_one: {{count}} finding from the {{results}} results in the SARIF ({{skipped}} suppressed or passing, not imported). Full import: whatever {{tool}} no longer reports is marked fixed.
imports.detail_full_other: {{count}} findings from the {{results}} results in the SARIF ({{skipped}} suppressed or passing, not imported). Full import: whatever {{tool}} no longer reports is marked fixed.
imports.detail_partial_one: {{count}} finding from the {{results}} results in the SARIF ({{skipped}} suppressed or passing, not imported). Partial import: nothing is marked fixed.
imports.detail_partial_other: {{count}} findings from the {{results}} results in the SARIF ({{skipped}} suppressed or passing, not imported). Partial import: nothing is marked fixed.

limitations.third_party: Findings reported by {{tool}} and imported as they came: Tamandua didn't analyze the code in this run.
limitations.partial: Partial import: findings {{tool}} no longer reports stay open until a full import or a manual fix.

errors.invalid_request: Invalid import: send asset, the SARIF document and, optionally, tool, scope (full or partial), commit and branch
errors.invalid_asset: Name the asset: its key or its name, such as owner/repo
errors.unknown_asset: There's no asset named {{asset}}: scan it or connect its repository first
errors.ambiguous_asset: Several assets are named {{asset}}: use the asset key
errors.invalid_scope: The scope must be full or partial
errors.invalid_commit: Invalid commit: use its SHA (7 to 64 hexadecimal characters)
